events.title: Rain Of Lead Livestream on Steam Next Fest Launch Day!!
events.summary: Hi players!Today is the first day of Steam Next Fest, and our developers will start a livestream this afternoon!You are welcome to bring any questions and feedback to the devs during the stream!We will openly answer your questions regarding Yuri elements, storyline and art design. Just keep your queries within content guidelines, haha.The Rain Of Lead demo is now available for download on the demo page!We have a huge request: please add Rain Of Lead to your Steam wishlist!!!Thank you all so much

events.title: Yuri × One-Hit Kill! 2D Side-Scroller Rain Of Lead is in Steam Next Fest October
events.summary: Rain Of Lead is a dieselpunk 2D pixel side-scrolling action game inspired by Katana ZERO. Every strike is lethal. No margin for mistake. Both the player and all enemies die from a single hit. Alternate between sword and pistol on the fly, weave through artillery barrages, slay infantry, cannons and tanks, confront a full army and experience visceral high-speed slaughter.Steam Next Fest October Demo is LIVE!
